description:
Roads (Road Creator Pro): asphalt roads with lane markings, sidewalks and curbs, lampposts with lights, guardrails,
fences, concrete and noise barriers, gravel shoulders, cat's eyes, patches and skid marks, bridges with supports, and the
street furniture around them (traffic lights, signs, barriers, crossings and road decals, parking, buildings).
Workflow: list -> junctions (intersection, roundabout, branch) -> create roads starting/ending on their exits -> place
(lights, signs, crossings) -> screenshot. Or generate a whole town in one call.
Roads that start or end on a junction exit snap to it and leave it straight, so the asphalt joins without gaps.
A road is built when it is made: to change one, remove it and create it again.
name: road

tools.description:
A side road's mouth on an existing road (a T-junction). Start the side road on the exit. Undoable.
Returns: The mouth and its exit. Fails on a side with a sidewalk (the mouth would cut it): branch from the other side or a road without one.

at.description: Near where on the road (cm); the nearest point on it is used. ([x, y, z] (cm))

road.description: The road to branch from (road.create id). (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

side.description: left, right (of the road's direction) or auto (the side At is on).

tools.name: road.branch

returnValue.description: The mouth and its exit. Fails on a side with a sidewalk (the mouth would cut it): branch from the other side or a road without one.
returnValue.title: RoadToolJunction

tools.description:
Builds a road along a route. The route is draped onto the ground below (terrain, landscape, anything with collision) every few metres, so the road follows hills. Undoable.
Returns: The road, its length and point count. Fails without the pack, with fewer than 2 points, or for an unknown type or setting.

follow_ground.description: Drape the route onto the ground (default true).

lampposts.description: none, left, right, center or both.

options.description: Any other Road Creator setting by name (road.list settings), e.g. {"Guardrails R": true, "💦 Wet": 0.6}. (Any JSON value)

points.description: Route [[x,y,z],...] (cm, at least 2), smoothed into a curve; z only matters where follow_ground is false. A first or last point on a junction exit (within 5 m) snaps to it and leaves the junction straight.

spline.description: Or follow a spline node (spline.create_spline) instead of points. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

type.description: Road type from list, e.g. "2-Lane Road" (default).

tools.name: road.create

returnValue.description: The road, its length and point count. Fails without the pack, with fewer than 2 points, or for an unknown type or setting.

points.description: Points the road follows (after draping onto the ground).

returnValue.title: RoadToolResult

tools.description:
Builds a whole town on the ground below: roads joined by real junctions, side streets and buildings facing the roads, trees on the verges and woods between the roads. organic: junctions scattered at random, joined by curving roads, roundabouts where 3+ roads meet, dead-end side streets. grid: a street grid with intersections, traffic lights and crossings. Make the ground first (build.create_terrain). Undoable piece by piece.
Returns: What was made.

buildings.description: At most this many buildings (0 for roads only).

location.description: Centre of the town (cm). ([x, y, z] (cm))

trees.description: About this many trees: street trees on the verges and woods between the roads (0 for none; needs the RuntimeFoliage trees).

tools.name: road.generate

tools.description:
A 4-way intersection (20 m square, for 2-lane roads with sidewalks). Undoable.
Returns: The piece and its 4 exits (start each road on one).

location.description: Centre (cm); dropped onto the ground. ([x, y, z] (cm))

tools.name: road.intersection

returnValue.description: The piece and its 4 exits (start each road on one).
returnValue.title: RoadToolJunction

tools.description:
Road types, the kinds road.place makes, and every road setting by name.
Returns: The catalog (installed false without the pack).
tools.name: road.list

returnValue.description: The catalog (installed false without the pack).

installed.description: False when the Road Creator Pro pack is not in the project.

settings.description: Every road setting road.create options accepts: name -> type.

returnValue.title: RoadToolCatalog

tools.description:
Places street furniture from the pack, standing on the ground. Undoable.
Returns: The object. Fails without the pack or for an unknown kind.

kind.description: From list kinds, e.g. traffic_lights, road_sign, destination_sign, lamp_post, boom_barrier, zebra_crossing, stop_line, speed_limit, parking_area, building, bench, cones.

location.description: Where (cm); dropped onto the ground. ([x, y, z] (cm))

options.description: The object's settings by name (reflection.list_properties on one shows them). (Any JSON value)

tools.name: road.place

returnValue.description: The object. Fails without the pack or for an unknown kind.

points.description: Points the road follows (after draping onto the ground).

returnValue.title: RoadToolResult

tools.description:
A roundabout (70 m ring with an island) with one 2-lane arm aimed at each point in toward. Undoable. Keep arms at least ~50 degrees apart.
Returns: The ring and one exit per arm, in the order of toward.

location.description: Centre (cm); dropped onto the ground. ([x, y, z] (cm))

toward.description: Where each road goes [[x,y,z],...] (one arm per point, 1 to 6).

tools.name: road.roundabout

returnValue.description: The ring and one exit per arm, in the order of toward.
returnValue.title: RoadToolJunction
